purpose: Fixed3M HalfCheetah memory controls: fresh-trajectory forecast usefulness and causal-selection sensitivity, no optimization

protocol.selection: full locally visible peer policy versus one peer removed, before gating; fixed thresholds including0.6
protocol.selection_limits: Sensitivity alone is not return benefit. Removed/shuffled features may be out of distribution. Each policy supplies its own trajectories.

environment.timeout_decoding: Gym TimeLimit.truncated; remaining done is terminal

protocol.actions: stochastic checkpoint policy; fixed parameters and normalization statistics
protocol.training_phase: checkpoint completed-episode counter is frozen, including warmup and causal gate phase
protocol.pairing: same observer and peer; exact history visibility pattern; distinct sensed action histories; no fallback
protocol.policy_intervention: shuffle eligible peer latents; preserve own query, observations, gates and action masks
protocol.decoder_intervention: shuffle prior means; retain original past, action anchor and peer identity
protocol.selection_statistic: KL(full locally visible peer set || one peer removed), before gating; frozen inputs and policy; sensitivity only
protocol.temporal_variance: center each coordinate within each environment episode; exclude warmup placeholders
protocol.history_baseline: visible past component mean or categorical mode; histogram NLL adds one pseudocount per real category; unknown histories excluded
protocol.interpretation: sensitivity is not usefulness; inspect paired forecast-loss changes and comparison counts

environment.timeout_decoding: Gym TimeLimit.truncated; remaining done is terminal

policy_observation_history.padding: left zeros; current observation at final slot
policy_observation_history.information: only this agent's existing local observations

interpretation: The history0 soft-attention checkpoint predicts fresh sensed actions better than persistence/history means and depends on peer latents. Its full-to-removed KL is policy sensitivity, not evidence of return gains from causal masking. Soft attention and the concatenating all/causal actors have different input architectures; do not transfer threshold success between them.
